image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a wombat sleeping inside a rocky burrow entrance. The animal's head and upper torso are visible, nestled against the rough, light-colored stone. The fur appears thick and coarse, dark brown to grey in color. The nose is large and prominent. One ear is visible, rounded and furry. The eyes are closed. The lighting is natural, casting shadows within the burrow.
